symptomShortText: Visible sink mark 0.35mm depth on top cosmetic cover rejected by customer inspection

defect.defectText: Sink mark and internal void on cosmetic injection molded surface

inspections.measuredValue: Messung Sink mark depth ergab 0,35mm; lt. Zeichnung max 0,05mm

causesIshikawa.description: Molding recipe REC-EE50-02 had holding pressure time set to 2.5s instead of validated 5.5s, switching to cooling before the 3.2mm boss gate solidified
Depth dial indicator GA-0190 calibrated and repeatability confirmed
Mold chiller water temperature 45C +/- 2C on both core and cavity sides

actions.actionText: Sort 210 units at customer facility and hold 450 finished enclosures in warehouse for visual audit
Restore validated holding pressure duration (5.5s @ 650 bar) and lock controller recipe with password
Connect injection molding machines to central MES recipe server with checksum validation to block unapproved USB parameter loading

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: Electronic Enclosure EE-50 molded on WC-MOLD-01 on 2026-08-04 after mold setup
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: Batches produced prior to 2026-08-04 or running on WC-MOLD-02 with locked recipe card
isIsNot.notes: Sink mark strictly restricted to the thick boss region due to premature hold pressure release
